blocks.text: Majhul nisbat: is being done, has been done

21-darsda majhul nisbatning ikki shaklini o'rgandik: **is done** (doim, odatda) va **was done** (o'tmishda). Bu darsda yana ikkitasi: **is being done** — harakat hozir jarayonda («ta'mirlanyapti»), va **has been done** — harakat tugagan, natijasi hozir bor («ta'mirlandi», «ta'mirlangan»). Qoida o'zgarmaydi: **be** ning kerakli zamoni + **V3**. Faqat endi be'ning o'zi ikki so'zdan iborat: is **being**, has **been**.

Present Continuous'da (hozirgi davomli zamon, → 3-dars) fe'l am / is / are + `-ing` bo'ladi. Majhul nisbatda shu `-ing` — be'ning `-ing` shakli **being**: am / is / are + **being** + V3. Ma'nosi: harakat aynan hozir yoki shu kunlarda davom etyapti, uni kim qilayotgani esa muhim emas yoki noma'lum. O'zbekchada bunga `-il-` + `-yapti` / `-moqda` to'g'ri keladi: ta'mir**lanyapti**, quri**lmoqda**, tekshiri**lyapti**.

items.text: Sorry, the lift **is being repaired** at the moment.
A new school **is being built** near our house.

blocks.text: **is done** va **is being done** ni adashtirmang. Faol nisbatdagi Present Simple va Present Continuous farqi (→ 8-dars) majhul nisbatda ham saqlanadi: **is cleaned** — odatda, muntazam («tozalanadi»); **is being cleaned** — aynan hozir («tozalanyapti»).

items.text: The windows **are cleaned** once a month.

blocks.text: Present Perfect (→ 15-dars) — have / has + V3. Majhul nisbatda unga be'ning V3 shakli **been** qo'shiladi: have / has + **been** + V3. Ma'nosi: harakat tugagan, natijasi hozir ko'rinib turibdi, qachon bo'lgani esa aytilmaydi: The window **has been broken** — deraza sindirilgan (hozir ham singan). just, already, yet (→ 16-dars) bu shakl bilan ko'p keladi: has **just** been sold, has **already** been paid, hasn't been checked **yet**. O'zbekchada: `-ildi`, `-ilgan`, `-ib bo'lindi`.
has been done yoki was done?

Bu — 20-darsdagi Present Perfect va Past Simple farqining o'zi. Aniq o'tgan vaqt bo'lsa (yesterday, last week, in 2019, two days ago) yoki **When ...?** bilan so'ralsa — **was done**. Vaqt aytilmasa va gap hozirgi natija haqida bo'lsa — **has been done**. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham ko'pincha «-ildi» bo'lgani uchun, inglizchada vaqt so'ziga qarang.

items.text: The road **has been closed**, so we need another way.
items.translation: Yo'l **yopilgan**, shuning uchun boshqa yo'l kerak.

items.text: The road **was closed** for two days last winter.
items.translation: O'tgan qishda yo'l ikki kunga **yopilgan edi**.

items.text: When **was** the road **closed**? — On Monday morning.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «The road is repairing.» → **The road is being repaired.** (yo'l o'zi hech narsani ta'mirlamaydi — `-ing` faol ma'no beradi); «My bag has stolen.» → **My bag has been stolen.** (been tushib qolmaydi); «The room has being cleaned.» → **has been cleaned**; «The house is been built.» → **is being built**; «The letter has been send.» → **has been sent** (V3).
being yoki been? **is / are / was / were** dan keyin — **being** (jarayon: is being built). **have / has** dan keyin — **been** (natija: has been built). Ikkalasidan keyin ham — doim V3.

Boshqa zamonlarda ham qoida bir xil — be'ning kerakli shakli + V3: was **being** done (o'tmishda jarayonda edi), will **be** done (kelajakda, → 27-dars). Barcha zamonlarda faol va majhul nisbat jadvali — 116-darsda.

examples.title: **is / are being** + V3: happening now
examples.description: Hozir jarayonda bo'lgan harakat, kim bajarayotgani muhim emas: am / is / are + **being** + V3. O'zbekchada: «-ilyapti», «-ilmoqda».

sentences.text: Our kitchen **is being painted**, so we're eating in the living room.
sentences.translation: Oshxonamiz **bo'yalyapti**, shuning uchun mehmonxonada ovqatlanyapmiz.

sentences.text: A new hospital **is being built** on the edge of the city.
sentences.translation: Shahar chetida yangi kasalxona **qurilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Quick, look out of the window — the old tree **is being cut** down!
sentences.translation: Tez, derazadan qarang — eski daraxt **kesilyapti**!

sentences.text: At the moment, the patient **is being examined** by two doctors.
sentences.translation: Hozir bemorni ikki shifokor **ko'rikdan o'tkazyapti**.

sentences.text: The rooms on the third floor **are being redecorated** this month.
sentences.translation: Uchinchi qavatdagi xonalar shu oy **qayta ta'mirlanyapti**.

sentences.text: Sorry, the computer system **is being updated** — please wait a few minutes.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, kompyuter tizimi **yangilanyapti** — iltimos, bir necha daqiqa kuting.

sentences.text: Right now the exam papers **are being marked**, so the results aren't ready.
sentences.translation: Hozir imtihon ishlari **tekshirilyapti**, shuning uchun natijalar hali tayyor emas.

sentences.text: Dinner **is being served** in the main hall.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat katta zalda **tortilyapti**.

sentences.text: Bekzod's phone **is being repaired**, so he's using his brother's old one.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning telefoni **ta'mirlanyapti**, shuning uchun u akasining eski telefonidan foydalanyapti.

sentences.text: In Samarkand, many old buildings **are being restored** for tourists.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda ko'plab qadimiy binolar sayyohlar uchun **qayta tiklanmoqda**.

examples.title: **is done** or **is being done**?
examples.description: **is done** — odatda, muntazam (Present Simple); **is being done** — aynan hozir, jarayonda (Present Continuous). O'zbekchada: «supuriladi» va «supurilyapti».

sentences.text: The streets in our area **are swept** every morning.
sentences.translation: Mahallamizdagi ko'chalar har kuni ertalab **supuriladi**.

sentences.text: Look, our street **is being swept** right now.
sentences.translation: Qarang, ko'chamiz hozir **supurilyapti**.

sentences.text: Usually the patients **are seen** by Dr Karimov.
sentences.translation: Odatda bemorlarni **doktor Karimov ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Today **they're being seen** by a young doctor from Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bugun ularni buxorolik yosh shifokor **ko'ryapti**.

sentences.text: Football matches **are shown** on this channel every Saturday.
sentences.translation: Bu kanalda har shanba futbol o'yinlari **ko'rsatiladi**.

sentences.text: The final **is being shown** live on all channels at the moment.
sentences.translation: Final hozir barcha kanallarda jonli **ko'rsatilyapti**.

sentences.text: In this factory, chocolate **is made** by machines.
sentences.translation: Bu fabrikada shokoladni **mashinalar tayyorlaydi**.

sentences.text: A special cake **is being made** for the boss's birthday.
sentences.translation: Boshliqning tug'ilgan kuni uchun maxsus tort **tayyorlanyapti**.

sentences.text: Usually our bags **are checked** quickly, but today every bag **is being opened**.
sentences.translation: Odatda sumkalarimiz tez **tekshiriladi**, bugun esa har bir sumka **ochib ko'rilyapti**.

sentences.text: Most cars **are washed** by hand here, but mine **is being washed** by a machine today.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda ko'p mashinalar qo'lda **yuviladi**, meniki esa bugun mashinada **yuvilyapti**.

examples.title: **Is** it **being** done? It **isn't being** done.
examples.description: Inkor: **isn't / aren't being** + V3. So'roq: **Is / Are** + ega + **being** + V3? Qisqa javob: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

sentences.text: **Is** your flat **being renovated**? — Yes, it is, so I'm staying with my parents.
sentences.translation: Kvartirangiz **ta'mirlanyaptimi**? — Ha, shuning uchun ota-onamnikida turibman.

sentences.text: The bridge **isn't being used** at the moment because it's too old.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik juda eski bo'lgani uchun hozir **ishlatilmayapti**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **being helped**, sir? — Yes, thanks.
sentences.translation: Janob, sizga **yordam berishyaptimi**? — Ha, rahmat.

sentences.text: What **is being built** next to the station? — A big shopping centre.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yonida nima **qurilyapti**? — Katta savdo markazi.

sentences.text: The old cinema **isn't being knocked down** — it**'s being turned** into a library.
sentences.translation: Eski kinoteatr **buzilmayapti** — u kutubxonaga **aylantirilyapti**.

sentences.text: Why **are** the roads **being closed** today? — There's a marathon in the city.
sentences.translation: Bugun yo'llar nega **yopilyapti**? — Shaharda marafon bor.

sentences.text: **Is** anything **being done** about the noise from the café downstairs?
sentences.translation: Pastdagi kafedan keladigan shovqin bo'yicha biror narsa **qilinyaptimi**?

sentences.text: Madina is upset because her ideas **aren't being taken** seriously at work.
sentences.translation: Madina xafa, chunki ishda uning g'oyalari jiddiy **qabul qilinmayapti**.

sentences.text: Where **is** the meeting **being held**? — In room 5, on the second floor.
sentences.translation: Majlis qayerda **o'tkazilyapti**? — Ikkinchi qavatdagi 5-xonada.

sentences.text: We **aren't being told** the truth about the new rules, I'm sure.
sentences.translation: Yangi qoidalar haqida bizga haqiqat **aytilmayapti**, ishonchim komil.

examples.title: **has / have been** + V3: the result is here now
examples.description: Harakat tugagan, natijasi hozir bor; qachon bo'lgani aytilmaydi: have / has + **been** + V3. O'zbekchada: «-ildi», «-ilgan», «-ibdi».

sentences.text: The kitchen **has been cleaned**, and the dishes are in the cupboard.
sentences.translation: Oshxona **tozalandi**, idishlar esa javonda.

sentences.text: Your order **has been sent** to your home address.
sentences.translation: Buyurtmangiz uy manzilingizga **jo'natildi**.

sentences.text: All the tickets for the concert **have been sold**.
sentences.translation: Konsertga barcha chiptalar **sotib bo'lingan**.

sentences.text: Somebody's car **has been parked** in front of our gate again!
sentences.translation: Kimningdir mashinasi yana darvozamiz oldiga **qo'yilgan**!

sentences.text: Look, the old sofa **has been taken** away.
sentences.translation: Qarang, eski divanni **olib ketishibdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has been chosen** as the best student of the year.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yilning eng yaxshi talabasi etib **saylandi**.

sentences.text: Several trees **have been blown** down by the wind.
sentences.translation: Shamol bir nechta daraxtni **qulatib yuboribdi**.

sentences.text: The prices **have been changed**, so please check them before you order.
sentences.translation: Narxlar **o'zgartirilgan**, shuning uchun buyurtma berishdan oldin ularni tekshiring.

sentences.text: Since the accident, a new traffic light **has been put** on this corner.
sentences.translation: Avariyadan keyin bu chorrahaga yangi svetofor **o'rnatildi**.

sentences.text: James **has been offered** a place at Oxford, and his parents are very proud.
sentences.translation: Jeymsga Oksforddan o'qish joyi **taklif qilindi**, ota-onasi u bilan juda faxrlanadi.

examples.title: **just / already / yet**: it has **just** been done
examples.description: just, already, yet (→ 16-dars) majhul nisbat bilan: has **just** been sold, has **already** been paid, **hasn't** been checked **yet**. Inkor: hasn't / haven't + been + V3.

sentences.text: The flat next door **has just been sold** to a young couple.
sentences.translation: Qo'shni kvartira **hozirgina** yosh er-xotinga **sotildi**.

sentences.text: Don't pay — the bill **has already been paid**.
sentences.translation: To'lamang — hisob **allaqachon to'langan**.

sentences.text: My homework **hasn't been checked** yet.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifam hali **tekshirilmagan**.

sentences.text: **Has** the new manager **been chosen** yet? — No, not yet.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer **tanlandimi**? — Yo'q, hali emas.

sentences.text: The rooms **have just been painted**, so please don't touch the walls.
sentences.translation: Xonalar **hozirgina bo'yaldi**, shuning uchun devorlarga tegmang.

sentences.text: Your visa **hasn't been approved** yet, so we need to wait.
sentences.translation: Vizangiz hali **tasdiqlanmagan**, shuning uchun kutishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: The guests are arriving, and the table **has already been laid**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelyapti, dasturxon esa **allaqachon yozilgan**.

sentences.text: Aziz's flight **has just been delayed** by two hours.
sentences.translation: Azizning reysi **hozirgina** ikki soatga **kechiktirildi**.

sentences.text: Most of the money **has already been spent**, and the holiday hasn't even started!
sentences.translation: Pulning ko'pi **allaqachon sarflangan**, ta'til esa hali boshlanmadi ham!

sentences.text: These emails **haven't been answered** yet because Sarah is on holiday.
sentences.translation: Bu xatlarga hali **javob berilmagan**, chunki Sara ta'tilda.

examples.title: Questions: **Has** it **been** done? — Yes, it has.
examples.description: So'roq: **Has / Have** + ega + **been** + V3? Qisqa javob: Yes, it has. / No, they haven't. So'roq so'z bilan: Where **has** it **been put**?

sentences.text: **Has** the parcel **been delivered**? — Yes, it has. It's on your desk.
sentences.translation: Posilka **yetkazildimi**? — Ha. U stolingizda.

sentences.text: **Have** the children **been fed**? — No, they haven't, and they're hungry.
sentences.translation: Bolalarga **ovqat berildimi**? — Yo'q, berilmadi, ularning qorni och.

sentences.text: Where **has** the TV remote **been put**? It isn't on the sofa.
sentences.translation: Televizor pulti **qayerga qo'yilgan**? Divanda yo'q.

sentences.text: **Has** your car **been fixed**? — Not yet, the garage is waiting for a part.
sentences.translation: Mashinangiz **tuzatildimi**? — Hali yo'q, ustaxona ehtiyot qism kutyapti.

sentences.text: How many people **have been invited** to the party? — About forty.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga necha kishi **taklif qilingan**? — Qirqqa yaqin.

sentences.text: **Have** you **ever been stopped** by the police? — No, never.
sentences.translation: Sizni hech **politsiya to'xtatganmi**? — Yo'q, hech qachon.

sentences.text: Why **hasn't** the snow **been cleared** from the road yet?
sentences.translation: Nega yo'ldan qor hali **tozalanmagan**?

sentences.text: **Has** a decision **been made** about the new park? — Yes, it has.
sentences.translation: Yangi park bo'yicha **qaror qabul qilindimi**? — Ha, qabul qilindi.

sentences.text: What **has been done** with the old furniture? — It was given to a charity.
sentences.translation: Eski mebellar bilan nima **qilindi**? — Xayriya tashkilotiga berildi.

sentences.text: **Have** all the tests **been marked**, or are some still on your desk?
sentences.translation: Hamma testlar **tekshirildimi** yoki ba'zilari hali stolingizdami?

examples.title: **has been done** or **was done**?
examples.description: Aniq o'tgan vaqt bo'lsa (yesterday, in 2018, two days ago) — **was done**; vaqt aytilmasa va natija hozir muhim bo'lsa — **has been done** (→ 20-dars).

sentences.text: Your room **has been cleaned**, and fresh towels are in the bathroom.
sentences.translation: Xonangiz **tozalandi**, toza sochiqlar vannaxonada.

sentences.text: The room **was cleaned** at nine o'clock this morning.
sentences.translation: Xona bugun ertalab soat to'qqizda **tozalangan**.

sentences.text: Some of the old houses in our street **have been knocked down**.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi eski uylarning bir qismi **buzib tashlangan**.

sentences.text: They **were knocked down** last summer, and new flats **were built** in their place.
sentences.translation: Ular o'tgan yozda **buzilgan**, o'rniga yangi ko'p qavatli uylar **qurilgan**.

sentences.text: My bike **has been repaired**, so I'm riding it to work again.
sentences.translation: Velosipedim **tuzatildi**, shuning uchun yana u bilan ishga boryapman.

sentences.text: It **was repaired** two days ago by a man in our street.
sentences.translation: Uni ikki kun oldin ko'chamizdagi bir usta **tuzatgan**.

sentences.text: **Has** the winner **been announced**? — Yes, it **was announced** an hour ago.
sentences.translation: G'olib **e'lon qilindimi**? — Ha, bir soat oldin **e'lon qilindi**.

sentences.text: When **was** this photo **taken**? — In 2018, at my cousin's wedding.
sentences.translation: Bu surat qachon **olingan**? — 2018-yilda, amakivachchamning to'yida.

sentences.text: The new road **has been opened**, and now the trip to Bukhara takes only four hours.
sentences.translation: Yangi yo'l **ochildi**, endi Buxoroga borish atigi to'rt soat oladi.

sentences.text: It **was opened** by the mayor on 1 September, with music and flags.
sentences.translation: U 1-sentabrda hokim tomonidan musiqa va bayroqlar bilan **ochilgan**.

examples.title: Dialogue: what's happening to the building?
examples.description: Dialog: qo'shnilar binodagi ta'mir haqida gaplashyapti. Majhul nisbatning to'rt shakli aralash: is done, is being done, was done, has been done.

sentences.text: — Hi, Sarah! What's that noise? **Is** something **being built**?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Sara! Bu qanday shovqin? Biror narsa **qurilyaptimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, the roof **is being repaired**. It **was damaged** in the storm last week.
sentences.translation: — Ha, tom **ta'mirlanyapti**. O'tgan hafta bo'ronda **shikastlangan** edi.

sentences.text: — Oh dear! **Has** your flat **been damaged** too?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Sizning kvartirangiz ham **zarar ko'rdimi**?

sentences.text: — Only the kitchen ceiling. Luckily, it **has already been painted**.
sentences.translation: — Faqat oshxona shifti. Baxtimizga, u **allaqachon bo'yaldi**.

sentences.text: — Who's paying for all this? I hope we **aren't being asked** for money.
sentences.translation: — Bularning hammasini kim to'layapti? Bizdan pul **so'rashmayapti**-ku, umid qilaman.

sentences.text: — No, don't worry. Repairs like this **are** always **paid** for by the company.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, xavotir olmang. Bunday ta'mir har doim kompaniya tomonidan **to'lanadi**.

sentences.text: — That's good. And **has** the lift **been fixed** yet?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Lift ham **tuzatildimi**?

sentences.text: — Not yet. A new part **was ordered** on Tuesday, but it **hasn't been delivered**.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. Seshanba kuni yangi ehtiyot qism **buyurtma qilindi**, lekin hali **yetkazilmadi**.

sentences.text: — So we're still walking up to the eighth floor! **Is** anything **being done** about it?
sentences.translation: — Demak, hali ham sakkizinchi qavatga piyoda chiqyapmiz! Bu bo'yicha biror narsa **qilinyaptimi**?

sentences.text: — I phoned the office this morning, and I **was told** that an engineer is coming tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — Bugun ertalab idoraga qo'ng'iroq qildim, menga ertaga usta kelishini **aytishdi**.
